sections.title: Replacing the Noun
sections.content:
When it is already clear what item you are discussing, you can drop the noun and use the demonstrative by itself as a pronoun:
- *¿Qué camiseta prefieres?* → *Prefiero **esta**.* (I prefer this one.)
- *¿Quieres este libro o **ese**?* → *Me llevo **este**.* (I'll take this one.)

sections.title: Common Shopping Phrases
rows: Which do you prefer, this one or that one over there?

items.english: Do you want this bag? No, I prefer that one over there.

items.spanish: Estos zapatos son grandes y esos son pequeños.
items.english: These shoes are big and those are small.

sections.content: According to the Royal Spanish Academy (RAE), demonstrative pronouns generally do not carry accent marks (*este*, *ese*, *aquel*), as context makes the meaning clear.
